declared_before_outcomes: Declared before any Scala development or confirmation stream was generated. An exploratory R prototype on R's own RNG (not a declared stream) preceded this declaration and is retained as exploration only.
seed_derivation: (root + domain*10000019 + (group+1)*1000003 + replicate*7919) mod 2147483646 + 1; Park-Miller 48271/2147483647 uniforms, Box-Muller Gaussians, voxel-major columns, 256 burn-in draws per run

pilot.role: runtime and recording check; no inference

development.role: exploratory diagnosis and candidate selection; no admission

confirmation.role: held-out, single execution after the candidate and its source are frozen; admission against original margins

cells.truth: run phi (0.30,0.05) then (0.55,-0.15); same for every voxel
cells.role: scope boundary: reported, not required; a failure restricts any across-run pooling claim

design: Unchanged corrected-GLS study design: two SPMG1 task epochs, run intercepts and six run-local DCT terms per run (16 columns), censor rows 23,24,60 then every 37 from 97 per run; voxel 0 null, voxel 1 task_a=0.75. Noise is continuous within each run; censoring never changes the generator.

engines.existing-known-restart: public FitPlan GLS with known phi and the current censor restart (homogeneous cells only)
engines.existing-voxelwise: public FitPlan corrected voxelwise GLS (homogeneous cells only)
engines.known-continuous: VoxelwiseArFgls Known(true phi per voxel/run), ContinuousMissing, Conditional

decisions: Candidate engines use p-values from the portable F upper tail with the reported numerator/denominator df (KR: scaled statistic and KR df). Existing engines keep the original fixed t/F critical values. Coverage is acceptance of H0 task_a=0.75 for voxel 1 at alpha 0.05.

acceptance.AR_mean_bias_rule: |bias| + qt(0.95, n-1) * sd/sqrt(n) <= 0.04 for each lag
acceptance.variance_ratio_rule: 90% percentile dataset-bootstrap interval of mean reported null variance / empirical null-estimate variance

candidate_selection: After the development profile only: among the four estimated ContinuousMissing engines, select the one passing the most acceptance criteria summed over the four admission cells on development data (ties: fewer pooling assumptions, i.e. PerRun before AcrossRuns, then Conditional before KenwardRoger). Record the selection, development evidence and a source hash in a mote decision and a commit before generating any confirmation stream. No margin, cell or criterion may change after this declaration.
confirmation_decision: scientific_pass requires the frozen candidate to pass every acceptance criterion in every admission cell on both JVM and JS with identical decisions; retained regardless of outcome. The scope-boundary cell is reported and limits claims. Existing engines are reported as baselines only.
scope_limits: No change to the production FitPlan GLS path or its defaults; the candidate is a separate typed entry point.
No group-level or iterative/robust inference claim.
Original 2026-10-08 adverse receipts and spent streams remain binding and are not reused.
